info.name: Farm To Home Backend v9 - Complete Production API Flow
info.description: Runs the complete Farm To Home Spring Boot API flow in a safe order: security, Firebase user sync, products, addresses, cart, coupons, COD orders, categories, banners, offers, farmers, delivery slots, favorites, reviews, notifications, preferences, support tickets, devices, and cleanup. A valid Firebase ID token is required.

exec: pm.test('Response time is below 10 seconds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000); });
